summary: Remote-controlled shell and filesystem agent driven by configurable WebSocket server
details: @yeaft/webchat-agent connects out to a WebSocket server (SERVER_URL / ctx.CONFIG.serverUrl) and routes server-originated messages into a set of host-control handlers. On a `terminal_create` message it spawns a PTY running `process.env.SHELL || 'bash'` (or pwsh/cmd) in the working directory, and on `terminal_input` it writes the message payload directly into that PTY via `term.pty.write(msg.data)` — giving the server operator arbitrary command execution on the host running the agent. The same message router in connection/message-router.js dispatches server messages to handlers for read_file, write_file, create_file, delete_files, move_files, copy_files, upload_to_dir (which base64-decodes `file.data` and writes it to `join(targetDir, file.name)`), and proxy_request / proxy_ws_* (arbitrary HTTP/WS relayed from the server through the host into any local port). The package's own service installer persists the agent as a systemd/launchd user service, so the outbound connection and full control plane are re-established at boot. Additionally, on agent startup index.js runs `git clone https://github.com/yeaft/yeaft-skills.git` into `~/.claude/plugins/marketplaces/yeaft-skills-dev` with subsequent `git pull --ff-only`, tracking unpinned upstream HEAD, and writes an enabledPlugins entry into the user's `~/.claude/settings.json`.
